easyPrerequisites: There are at least six land cards between your graveyard and the battlefield under your control, one of which must be a Swamp, that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least six land cards in your graveyard, with one of those cards being a Swamp.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.
